rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Kantei's account 福田内閣の発足, dated 26 September 2007, says that on the morning of the 26th, the day after the Diet designated 福田康夫 as the 91st Prime Minister (58th person), the Prime Minister's Imperial appointment ceremony (親任式) and the ministers' attestation took place at the Palace.
